            (id, account_id, from_account_id, last_status_id, notifications_count)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)

            last_status_id = EXCLUDED.last_status_id,
            notifications_count = EXCLUDED.notifications_count,
            updated_at = now()
